characterized_weaknesses: The report schema permits verified findings with empty evidence and source arrays.
Summary counts are not checked against findings and not_verified arrays.
Expert dispatch documents obsolete fork_context and agent_type fields.
Project detection lacks first-class agent/plugin, library/SDK, infrastructure/IaC, and CI/tooling labels.
Cold personas share one sequential browser session.
Browser tasks do not encode a mandatory stop-before-external-write boundary.
Playwright MCP uses an unpinned @latest package and may prompt on first use.

model_eval.protocol: Two isolated gpt-5.6-sol/high read-only reviewers each received five disjoint raw cases, no same-surface clean/seeded pair, no oracle, and the unchanged v0.2.3 experts contract.
model_eval.reason: Model-run evaluations remain separate from predictable local validation; WP-02 repeats this bounded protocol against the same blinded corpus.
